title: Best Scriptwriters for Hire (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a scriptwriter for YouTube, ads, explainers or short films: what to include, how to brief it, price factors and red flags.
intro: A script decides what a video says, in what order, and how long it takes. Scriptwriters work on YouTube videos, ads, explainer videos, podcasts and short films. Scripts go wrong when the goal is unclear, the length does not match the format, or the writing reads well but sounds unnatural spoken aloud. This guide helps you order scripts that work on camera.

faq.q: What kind of script do I need?
faq.a: Say the format: a YouTube video, a short ad, an explainer, a podcast episode or a film scene. Each has different structure, length and style.

faq.q: How long should the script be?
faq.a: It depends on the video length. Spoken scripts run at a fairly steady pace, so agree on the target video length and ask the writer to time the script by reading it aloud.

faq.q: Will the script include visual directions?
faq.a: Ask. Many video scripts include notes on what appears on screen, shots or graphics. This helps editors and animators.

faq.q: Can the writer research the topic?
faq.a: Many can. Say whether you will provide the facts or need research, and ask for sources on factual claims.
Confirm you receive full rights to use and change the script.
